recordedStone.title: GoStoneSounds.ogg
recordedStone.author: billhails2
recordedStone.downloadKind: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the login-required original OGG
recordedStone.recording: Author describes five real Yunzi stone placements, recorded with a Marantz Professional Umpire microphone. Placements 1-3 use a wooden tabletop board with legs; 4-5 use a thin shin-kaya board.

rejectedSyntheticStone: Archived outside Assets; no runtime reference remains. UI click remains an original synthesized short tick.
behavior: BGM continues from its current position in lobby, match, pause, retry confirmation and leave confirmation.
Gameplay remains paused during pause/confirmation dialogs.
Music OFF, application pause/focus loss and pending ads still suppress music as intended.
Real recorded Go-stone placement plays for player and AI moves at scale 1.0.
Serialized buttons each play one UI click at scale 0.55; disabled buttons and sound OFF remain silent.

previousFullRegression.scope: 100/100 after modal music/UI-click changes but BEFORE real stone recording replacement. Final recording verified by the 11-test focused rerun.

listenerMeasurement: AudioListener.GetOutputData during Unity Play; engine output, not microphone or human listening.
preservation: Only five baseline Assets changed. Other baseline Assets, data, artwork, layout prefabs, original music and original Move.wav preserved.
reproduction: Archived public HQ MP3 checksum verified.
Tools/PrepareRecordedStone.py trims real placement; two runs produced identical WAV bytes.
ApplySoundEffects saves clips, serialized button coverage and legal notices.
limits: No human listening or OS loudspeaker measurement.
No new WebGL/Android build, browser or physical-device validation.
